results.title: SecureLLM: A Unified Framework for Privacy-Focused ...
results.content: In contrast to solutions that focus solely on one technique (e.g., differential privacy during training [8] or homomorphic encryption for raw data [9]), SecureLLM addresses every phase of the LLM lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, and inference) through a combination of lightweight cryptography, MPC-based decentralized updates, and differential privacy for inference. **The integration of security layers.** The three layers of SecureLLM are designed to work in unison: lightweight cryptography secures the data during transit, decentralized fine-tuning aggregates the encrypted gradients securely, and differential privacy at inference ensures that the final outputs are protected against membership inference. By layering these approaches, SecureLLM provides multi-pronged defense: encryption restricts data exposure, MPC-based aggregation resists untrusted nodes, and DP-based inference protects end users.Even our updated demonstration in Section 5.5—using DistilGPT-2 on a 1000-sample WikiText-2 subset—showed that adding differential privacy increased the training time by about 47.9% yet reduced the membership inference accuracy from 66.3% to 60.8%.
